audit_result.proof_trace: `createTempRegistrationInternal` performs no rate-limit check per `card_id` before deleting all incomplete temp_registrations for a card and inserting a new one (L161-170); no in-memory counter, no DB window-count query, no middleware throttle, and no DB constraint exists anywhere in the codebase. Since `createTempRegistration` is a Next.js Server Action exposed as a public HTTP POST endpoint, an unauthenticated attacker can call it at will, continuously invalidating the active QR token for a target card_id and spamming DB DELETE+INSERT pairs.
audit_result.attack_scenario: An attacker sends rapid HTTP POST requests to the `createTempRegistration` Server Action endpoint with a victim's `card_id`; each request deletes the current active temp_registration and inserts a new one, continuously invalidating the victim's displayed QR code mid-registration and preventing card enrollment from completing.

PROP-kintai-v3-st-pre-005.text: createTempRegistration must rate-limit per card_id to prevent registration reset spam.
PROP-kintai-v3-st-pre-005.assertion: forall card_id, window: count(create_temp_reg(card_id, window)) <= RATE_LIMIT
